items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: my company in New York was bookin' me--Shaw's Booking Agency.

ctx.x: So, afterwards, we stay down there all summer, through Texas; Mississippi; Louisiana; all down through Arkansas; Nashville, Tennessee. We played every nightclub and every university there was. An' uh, I kept Herman with me ten...twelve years, back an' forth.

Then we started playin' universities. I went back to New York, an' my company in New York was bookin' me--Shaw's Booking Agency. So, they started givin' up...puttin' out...I'm gettin' a kinda ahead of myself there now.

So, anyway, I run into the cats had Atlantic Recording Company ...'cause I had...I knew one of the fellows a long time ago...who used to work for Nashville...National...National Records Company. He used to travel all around all...wherever I was he'd come...fellow he was comin' to record me. All I gotta do is call him up, say, "I'm ready to record," an' he would get on a plane an' come. We get us a band and make records.
